Name: DE-TypologyGroupsDepartments
Description: Extracts typology groups associated to departments.
Statement:
select  tgd.Oid as Id,
        utg.Oid as TypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as TypologyGroup,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department
from    UserTypologyGroupDepartment tgd
            join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = tgd.Department
            join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = tgd.UserTypologyGroup
where   GCRecord is null
